fact: The Medusa submarine cable (8,700 km, linking Libya to Mediterranean countries) was inaugurated on 10 May 2025 at Misrata, per state holding company LPTIC as reported by Libya Herald; Libya United International Company (LUIC) signed the connection contract in November 2023.
Capacity reports the Medusa cable's Misrata landing in Libya was inaugurated under a construction and maintenance agreement with LITC, linking Misrata to Marseille and Mazara del Vallo.
